evidence.excerpt: We just released some insights from testing 32 AI models for child safety. The 3 most interesting to me are: 1. Models are not getting safer over time (see chart below). 2. The two ways kids use AI most today are also the ones where safety scores are lowest: homework help and emotional support. 3. Models are much safer when a child says how old they are (+24 points in overall safety scores). https://korabench.substack.com/p/we-tested-32-ai-models-for-child
